'''Juri Ishmaak''' is a ship Engineer based at '''Pater's Memorial''' in the '''Giryak''' system. A retired mercenary combat pilot, he operates a broad workshop covering mines, sensors, scanners, missiles, and several Live-only mining and explosive-weapon services.<ref name="edwiki-juri">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Juri_Ishmaak Juri Ishmaak], Elite Dangerous Wiki. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

His conventional maximum-grade specialties are the [[Detailed Surface Scanner]], [[Mine Launcher]], and [[Sensors]]. Current Live records add maximum-grade services for the [[Abrasion Blaster]], Enzyme Missile Rack, and [[Mining Laser]].<ref name="inara-juri">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/13/ Juri Ishmaak — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

== Location ==

* '''System:''' Giryak
* '''Body:''' Giryak 2 a
* '''Facility:''' Pater's Memorial
* '''Engineer scope:''' Ship mines, missiles, scanners, sensors, and mining weapons
* '''Referral required:''' [[Felicity Farseer]]
* '''System permit required:''' No

== Access requirements ==

Access to Juri Ishmaak has three stages:<ref name="inara-juri" /><ref name="edwiki-juri" />

# Reach '''Grade 3 access plus at least one-third progress toward Grade 4''' with [[Felicity Farseer]] to receive his referral.
# Claim '''more than 50 Federal combat bonds'''.
# Provide the Federal combat-bond value shown on the Engineer invitation: current sources report either '''100,000 CR''' or '''1,000,000 CR'''.

The meeting condition counts qualifying bonds, while the final contribution is based on their credit value. Current sources do not establish the condition that selects the lower or higher amount, so Commanders should treat the value shown on their own invitation as authoritative. The complete ordered process and combat-bond workflow belong to [[Unlocking Juri Ishmaak]].

== Workshop reputation ==

Reputation with Juri Ishmaak increases by:<ref name="inara-juri" />

* crafting modifications at his workshop; or
* handing in bounty vouchers or combat bonds at Pater's Memorial.

Higher reputation opens the grades that Juri supports. INARA notes that station services may not appear immediately after the first unlock; beginning a new game session can make those services available.<ref name="inara-juri" />

The available conventional modification families, effects, trade-offs, and recipes belong to [[Engineering Blueprints]]. Compatible secondary modifications belong to [[Experimental Effects]].

=== Operations-era services ===

Current Live records add eight Operations-era services to Juri's workshop:<ref name="frontier-operations">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-4-0-0 Elite Dangerous: Operations — Update Notes], Frontier Developments, 30 June 2026. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref><ref name="inara-juri" />

* '''Far-reaching''' [[Abrasion Blaster]] engineering through Grade 5<ref name="inara-abrasion">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/217/ Abrasion Blaster — Far-reaching], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>
* '''Long Range Detailed''' [[Detailed Surface Scanner]] engineering through Grade 5<ref name="inara-dss">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/205/ Detailed Surface Scanner — Long Range Detailed], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>
* '''High-yield''' Enzyme Missile Rack engineering through Grade 5<ref name="inara-enzyme">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/224/ Enzyme Missile Rack — High-yield], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>
* '''Long Range''' [[Mining Laser]] engineering through Grade 5<ref name="inara-mining">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/218/ Mining Laser — Long Range], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>
* '''Drag''', '''Exposing''', '''Lightweight Thermal''', and '''Lockdown''' [[Seeker Missile Rack]] engineering through Grade 3<ref name="inara-drag">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/219/ Seeker Missile Rack — Drag], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref><ref name="inara-exposing">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/227/ Seeker Missile Rack — Exposing], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref><ref name="inara-thermal">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/220/ Seeker Missile Rack — Lightweight Thermal], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref><ref name="inara-lockdown">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/221/ Seeker Missile Rack — Lockdown], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

These services are not part of Legacy Engineering. Exact modifiers, costs, and compatibility belong to the corresponding [[Engineering Blueprints|Blueprint]] records rather than this Engineer article.

== Blueprint pinning and remote work ==

After sufficient reputation has been earned, one Juri Ishmaak blueprint can be pinned for use through [[Remote Engineering]]. A pinned blueprint cannot exceed the grade he offers, and Experimental Effects still require an appropriate workshop visit.

== Direct referrals ==

Juri Ishmaak directly introduces two Engineers after the Commander reaches Grade 3 access and progresses approximately one-third of the way toward Grade 4 with him:

* '''[[The Sarge]]'''<ref name="inara-sarge">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/17/ The Sarge — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>
* '''[[Colonel Bris Dekker]]'''<ref name="inara-dekker">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/14/ Colonel Bris Dekker — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

Each referral reveals an Engineer; it does not satisfy that Engineer's own meeting or unlock requirements. Their locations, requirements, services, and later referrals belong to their individual articles. For the complete network, see [[Engineer Unlock Guide]].
